page.title: Masu haɗawa
page.intro: Haɗa asusun tallan ku. Jagoranci daga tallace-tallacenku suna zuwa cikin Jagorana ta atomatik, tare da kashewa da farashi akan kowane gubar.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form yana kaiwa cikin Jagorana, kashe kuɗi na yau da kullun da farashi akan kowane jagorar, da ingancin jagorar da aka aika zuwa LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

connect.title: Haɗa LinkedIn
connect.intro: Shiga tare da asusun LinkedIn wanda ke sarrafa tallan ku. Leadrat yana karanta lissafin tallan ku kawai, Jagorar Lead Gen Form da kididdigar talla, kuma yana aika jujjuyawar da kuka kunna.
connect.need1: Matsayi akan asusun talla na LinkedIn (Mai kallo ko mafi girma).
connect.need2: Matsayi a kan shafin kamfanin da aka haɗa (Mai gudanarwa, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator ko Analyst) - LinkedIn yana buƙatar shi don raba jagoranci.
connect.need3: Tambayar lambar waya akan Lead Gen Forms - ba za a iya ƙara jagora ba tare da lambar waya ba.

connection.fetchTitle: Zamo jagora ta hanyar kwanan wata
connection.fetchHint: Ana duba sabbin jagororin kowane ƴan mintuna kuma ana sake duba kwanaki 7 na ƙarshe a kowace rana, don haka ba a rasa komai. Yi amfani da wannan don jagora daga kafin ku haɗa, ko don sake duba lokaci (har zuwa kwanaki 90 a lokaci ɗaya). An tsallake jagoran jagora a cikin Leadrat .

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Faɗa LinkedIn wanne daga cikin jagororin sa ya zama masu sa ido na gaske. Lokacin da jagorar LinkedIn ya kai matsayin da kuka zaɓa a ƙasa, Leadrat ya ba da rahoton shi zuwa LinkedIn , don haka rahoton yakin ku ya nuna ingancin jagora kuma LinkedIn na iya samun ƙarin mutane kamar mafi kyawun jagoranci. Sai kawai ID jagorar LinkedIn da zanta na imel ɗin ta hanya ɗaya.
capi.noRules: Ba a yi taswira ba tukuna.
capi.created: Canjin da aka ƙirƙira akan LinkedIn kuma an tsara shi.
